summary: Sources give 2 different answers to “On what date did Nevada probate commissioner Edmund Gorman Jr. rule against Rupert and Lachlan Murdoch in the family trust dispute?”: 2024-12-07 (9 sources), 2024-12-09 (2 sources). No primary source found.

Sources give 3 different answers to “What percentage of Fox Corporation's Class B common stock will LGC Holdco own following the 2025 settlement transactions?”: 36.2 (8 sources), 38.7 (1 source), 38.8 (5 sources). A primary source says 38.8.

text: Sources agree that the trial began on September 16, 2024 at the Washoe County Courthouse in Reno, Nevada; that News Corp announced the settlement resolution on September 8, 2025; that the settlement was worth $3.3 billion; that LGC Holdco will own 33.1% of News Corp's Class B common stock; and that 16,900,000 shares of Fox Corporation Class B stock held by the trust will be publicly sold to fund the cash consideration. Sources disagree on the date Nevada probate commissioner Edmund Gorman Jr. ruled against Rupert and Lachlan Murdoch (December 7 versus December 9, 2024) and on the percentage of Fox Corporation Class B common stock LGC Holdco will own (mostly 36.2% versus figures of 38.7%, 38.8%, and 36%). A primary source gives 38.8 where others say 36.2 or 38.7; the other disputes have none.
